description: S1: one operation at a time, one microsecond before the deadline and exactly at it (naive)
notes: Every answer is right, on the naive version: one operation at a time, nothing can go wrong. Sequential tests cannot see the race of collect-expiry-naive.

Lazy expiry on reads: at the deadline the shelf map, GET and the member's count already treat the reservation as expired while its rows still say ACTIVE / RESERVED. The sweep only stores what every reader already applies.
Collecting removed the deadline: a day later the copy is still ON_LOAN and the collected reservation is no sweep candidate.
